text: Catalog Request Message (CRM) The Catalog Request Message (CRM) shall be sent by the participant agent acting as Consumer to a Catalog Service
CRM response The Catalog Service shall respond to a CRM with a Catalog - The received Catalog must be a instance of a DCAT Catalog

CRM properties The CRM shall have a @context and a @type properties - The value of the context shall contain https://w3id.org/dspace/2024/1/context.jsonld - The value of the type shall be CatalogRequestMessage
CRM filter property WHERE the CRM have a "filter" property it shall contains an implementation-specific query or filter expression type supported by the Catalog Service
Dataset Request Message (DRM) The Dataset Request Message (DRM) shall be sent by the participant agent acting as Consumer to a Catalog Service
DRM response The Catalog Service shall respond to a DRM with a Dataset - The received Dataset must be a instance of a DCAT Dataset
DRM properties The DRM shall have a @context and a @type properties
DRM dataset property The DRM shall have a "dataset" property - The dataset property must contain the id of the Dataset.
DRM response status The response from CRM and DRM shall be either ACK or ERROR

ACK-Catalog A Catalog shall have a @context, @id, @type and participantId properties - The value of the context shall contain https://w3id.org/dspace/2024/1/context.jsonld - The value of the type shall be Catalog
Catalog datasets A Catalog shall have zero to many Datasets
Catalog data services A Catalog shall have one to many Data Services that reference a Connector where Datasets may be obtained.
ACK - Dataset A Dataset shall have an @id property - The id must be a unique identifier
Dataset hasPolicy property A Dataset shall have at least one hasPolicy attribute that contains an Offer defining the Policy associated with the Dataset.
Dataset distribution property A Dataset shall have a distribution property. - A Dataset shall hold at least one Distribution object in the distribution attribute.

DataService distribution origin Each DataService object shall have at least one DataService which specifies where the distribution is obtained. - A DataService specifies the endpoint for initiating a Contract Negotiation and Transfer Process
Offer id property An Offer shall have an @id property - The id must be a unique identifier
Offer unique Dataset An Offer shall be unique to a Dataset
ERROR - Catalog Error WHEN a CRM or a DRM and the Provider cannot provide its Catalog to the requester, a Catalog Error shall be sent.

Catalog Error properties The Catalog Error shall have a @context and a @type properties - The value of the context shall contain https://w3id.org/dspace/2024/1/context.jsonld - The value of the type shall be CatalogError
Catalog Error code property WHERE there is a implementation-specific error code, a "code" property shall be included in the Catalog Error
Catalog Error reasons property WHERE there are implementation-specific error objects, a "reasons" array property shall be included in the Catalog Error
Endpoint catalog/request The Catalog Service shall implement the catalog/request endpoint

Endpoint catalog/request response WHEN the request to the catalog/request endpoint is successful, the Catalog Service shall return an HTTP 200 (OK) with a response body containing a Catalog - The returned Catalog must be a DCAT Catalog
Endpoint catalog/datasets/:id The Catalog Service shall implement the catalog/datasets/:id endpoint

Endpoint catalog/datasets/:id response WHEN the request to the catalog/datasets/:id endpoint is successful, the Catalog Service shall return an HTTP 200 (OK) with a response body containing a Dataset - The returned Dataset must be a DCAT Dataset
Policy Identifier All Policy types (Offer, Agreement) shall contain an unique identifier in the form of a URI.
ODRL Agreement Target An ODRL Agreement shall have a target property containing the Dataset id.
Contract Request Message (CRM) The Contract Request Message (CRM) shall be sent by a Consumer to initiate a CN or to respond to a Contract Offer Message sent by a Provider.
CRM Success State A Contract Negotiation (CN) shall transition to the REQUESTED state as a result of a sucessful CRM.
CRM Failure State A Contract Negotiation (CN) shall transition to the TERMINATED state as a result of an unsucessful CRM.

CRM Context and Type The CRM shall have a @context and a @type properties - The value of the context shall contain https://w3id.org/dspace/2024/1/context.jsonld - The value of the type shall be ContractRequestMessage

CRM Callback Address The CRM shall have a callbackAddress property - The callbackAddress property must be a string with a URL indicating where messages to the consumer should be sent. - If the address is not understood, the Provider must return an UNRECOVERABLE error.

CRM Offer Property The CRM shall have a offer property - The Consumer must include an offer property, which itself must have a @id property (offer.@id). - An offer.@id will generally refer to an Offer contained in a Catalog

CRM Offer Target The Offer inside a CRM shall have a odrl:target attribute. - The contained Rules of the Offer must not have any odrl:target attributes to prevent inconsistencies with the ODRL inferencing rules for compact policies
CRM Consumer PID The CRM shall have a consumerPid property
Contract Offer Message (COM) The Contract Offer Message (COM) shall be sent by a Provider to initiate a CN or to respond to a CRM sent by a Consumer.
COM Success State A CN shall transition to the OFFERED state as a result of a sucessful COM.
COM Failure State A CN shall transition to the TERMINATED state as a result of an unsucessful COM.

COM Context and Type The COM shall have a @context and a @type properties - The value of the context shall contain https://w3id.org/dspace/2024/1/context.jsonld - The value of the type shall be ContractOfferMessage
COM Callback Address The COM shall have a callbackAddress property
COM Offer Property The COM shall have a offer property

COM Offer Target The Offer inside a COM shall have a odrl:target attribute. - The contained Rules of the Offer must not have any odrl:target attributes to prevent inconsistencies with the ODRL inferencing rules for compact policies
Contract Agreement Message (CAM) The Contract Agreement Message (CAM) shall be sent by a Provider when it agrees to a contract. - The CAM contains the complete Agreement.
CAM Success State A CN shall transition to the AGREED state as a result of a sucessful CAM.
CAM Failure State A CN shall transition to the TERMINATED state as a result of an unsucessful CAM.

CAM Context and Type The CAM shall have a @context and a @type properties - The value of the context shall contain https://w3id.org/dspace/2024/1/context.jsonld - The value of the type shall be ContractAgreementMessage
CAM PID Properties The CAM shall have a consumerPid property and a providerPid property.
CAM ODRL Agreement The CAM shall contain an ODRL Agreement
Agreement Timestamp An Agreement shall contain a timestamp property defined as an XSD DateTime type
Agreement Assigner and Assignee An Agreement shall contain an assigner and assignee properties. - The contents of these properties are a dataspace-specific unique identifier of the Agreement parties.

Agreement Target An Agreement shall contain a odrl:target property - None of the Rules of the Agreement must have any odrl:target attributes to prevent inconsistencies with the ODRL inferencing rules for compact policies.
Contract Agreement Verification Message (CAVM) The Contract Agreement Verification Message (CAVM) shall be sent by a Consumer to verify the acceptance of an Agreement.
CAVM Success State A CN shall transition to the VERIFIED state as a result of a sucessful CAVM.
CAVM Failure State A CN shall transition to the TERMINATED state as a result of an unsucessful CAVM.

CAVM Context and Type The CAVM shall have a @context and a @type properties - The value of the context shall contain https://w3id.org/dspace/2024/1/context.jsonld - The value of the type shall be ContractAgreementVerificationMessage
CAVM PID Properties The CAVM shall have a consumerPid property and a providerPid property
CAVM Validation Error IF the contract specified in the CAVM cannot be validated or is incorrect THEN the Provider shall respond with an error.
Contract Negotiation Event Message (CNEM) The Contract Negotiation Event Message (CNEM) shall be sent by a Provider to finalize an Agreement.

CNEM Context and Type The CNEM shall have a @context and a @type properties - The value of the context shall contain https://w3id.org/dspace/2024/1/context.jsonld - The value of the type shall be ContractNegotiationEventMessage
CNEM PID Properties The CNEM shall have a consumerPid property and a providerPid property
CNEM Event Type The CNEM shall have a eventType property
CNEM Validation Error IF the contract specified in the CNEM cannot be validated or is incorrect THEN the Consumer shall respond with an error.
CNEM Accepted State WHEN the CNEM is sent by a Consumer with an eventType property set to ACCEPTED the CN shall transition to the ACCEPTED state.
Contract Negotiation Termination Message (CNTM) The Contract Negotiation Termination Message (CNTM) shall be sent by a Consumer or Provider to indicate it has cancelled the CN sequence.

CNTM Context and Type The CNTM shall have a @context and a @type properties - The value of the context shall contain https://w3id.org/dspace/2024/1/context.jsonld - The value of the type shall be ContractNegotiationTerminationMessage
CNTM PID Properties The CNTM shall have a consumerPid property and a providerPid property
CNTM Termination State A CN shall transition to the TERMINATED state as a result of an exchanged CNTM
Contract Negotiation ACK The Contract Negotiation shall be an object returned by a Consumer or Provider indicating a successful state change happened.

ACK Context and Type The Contract Negotiation object shall have a @context and a @type properties - The value of the context shall contain https://w3id.org/dspace/2024/1/context.jsonld - The value of the type shall be ContractNegotiation
ACK PID Properties The Contract Negotiation object shall have a consumerPid property and a providerPid property
ACK State Property The Contract Negotiation object shall have a "state" property.
Contract Negotiation Error (CNE) The Contract Negotiation Error (CNE) shall be an object returned by a Consumer or Provider indicating an error has occurred.

CNE Context and Type The Contract Negotiation object shall have a @context and a @type properties - The value of the context shall contain https://w3id.org/dspace/2024/1/context.jsonld - The value of the type shall be ContractNegotiationError
CNE PID Properties The Contract Negotiation object shall have a consumerPid property and a providerPid property
Endpoint negotiations A CN shall be accessible by a Consumer or Provider by sending a GET request to negotiations/:providerPid
Negotiations Success Response WHEN the CN is found and the client is authorized, the Provider shall return an HTTP 200 (OK) response and a body containing the Contract Negotiation (ACK).
Endpoint negotiations/request WHEN a Consumer POSTs an initiating CRM to the negotiations/request endpoint, a CN shall be started and placed in the REQUESTED state.

Endpoint negotiations/request Success Response WHEN the request to the negotiations/request endpoint is successful, the Provider shall return an HTTP 201 (Created) response and a body containing the Contract Negotiation (ACK).
Endpoint negotiations/:providerPid/request A Consumer shall be able to make an Offer by POSTing a CRM to the negotiations/:providerPid/request endpoint.

Endpoint negotiations/:providerPid/request Success Response WHEN the message to the negotiations/:providerPid/request endpoint is successfully processed, the Provider shall return an HTTP 200 (OK) response.
Endpoint negotiations/:providerPid/events A Consumer shall be able to POST a CNEM to the negotiations/:providerPid/events endpoint to accept the current Provider's Offer.

Endpoint negotiations/:providerPid/events Success Response WHEN the CN's state is successfully transitioned after a request to the negotiations/:providerPid/events endpoint, the Provider shall return an HTTP code 200 (OK)

Endpoint negotiations/:providerPid/events Error Response WHERE the current Offer was created by the Consumer, the Provider must return an HTTP code 400 (Bad Request) with a Contract Negotiation Error in the response body.
Endpoint negotiations/:providerPid/agreement/verification A Consumer shall be able to POST a CAVM to the negotiations/:providerPid/agreement/verification endpoint to verify an Agreement.

Endpoint negotiations/:providerPid/agreement/verification Success Response WHEN the CN's state is successfully transitioned after a request to the negotiations/:providerPid/agreement/verification endpoint, the Provider shall return an HTTP code 200 (OK)
Endpoint negotiations/:providerPid/termination A Consumer shall be able to POST a CNTM to the negotiations/:providerPid/termination endpoint to terminate a CN.

Endpoint negotiations/:providerPid/termination Sucess Response WHEN the CN's state is successfully transitioned after a request to the negotiations/:providerPid/termination endpoint, the Provider shall return an HTTP code 200 (OK)
Endpoint negotiations/offers WHEN a Provider POSTs a COM to the negotiations/offers endpoint a CN shall be started and placed in the OFFERED state.

Endpoint negotiations/offers Success Response WHEN the request to the negotiations/offers endpoint is successful, the Consumer shall return an HTTP 201 (Created) response and a body containing the Contract Negotiation (ACK).
Endpoint negotiations/:consumerPid/offers A Provider shall be able to make an Offer by POSTing a COM to the negotiations/:consumerPid/offers endpoint

Endpoint negotiations/:consumerPid/offers Sucess Response WHEN the message to the negotiations/:consumerPid/offers endpoint is successfully processed, the Consumer shall return an HTTP 200 (OK) response.
Endpoint negotiations/:consumerPid/agreement A Provider shall be able to POST a CAM to the negotiations/:consumerPid/agreement endpoint to create an Agreement.

Endpoint negotiations/:consumerPid/agreement Success Response WHEN the CN's state is successfully transitioned after a request to the negotiations/:consumerPid/agreement endpoint, the Consumer shall return an HTTP code 200 (OK)
Endpoint negotiations/:consumerPid/events WHEN a Provider POSTs a CNEM to the negotiations/:consumerPid/events endpoint with an eventType of FINALIZED, the system shall finalize the Agreement.

Endpoint negotiations/:consumerPid/events Sucess Response WHEN the CN's state is successfully transitioned after a request to the negotiations/:consumerPid/events endpoint, the Consumer shall return an HTTP code 200 (OK)
Endpoint negotiations/:consumerPid/termination WHEN a Provider POSTs a CNTM to the negotiations/:providerPid/termination endpoint, the system shall terminate the CN.

Endpoint negotiations/:consumerPid/termination Success Response WHEN the CN's state is successfully transitioned after a request to the negotiations/:providerPid/termination endpoint, the Consumer shall return an HTTP code 200 (OK)
CNEM Finalized State WHEN the CNEM is sent by a Provider with an eventType property set to FINALIZED the CN shall transition to the FINALIZED state.

Transfer Request Message (TRM) The Transfer Request Message (TRM) shall be sent by the participant agent acting as Consumer that requests access to the dataset - A TP is initiated by a Consumer using this message
TP REQUESTED state A Transfer Process (TP) shall transition to the REQUESTED state as a result of an exchanged TRM - The status of a TP after a sucessful exchange of a TRM must be REQUESTED

TRM required properties The TRM shall have a @context and a @type properties - The value of the context shall contain https://w3id.org/dspace/2024/1/context.jsonld - The value of the type shall be TransferRequestMessage
consumerPid property in TRM The TRM shall have a consumerPid property - The consumerPid should refer to the transfer id of the Consumer side - The consumerPid property must be a string

agreementId property in TRM The TRM shall have a agreementId property - The agreementId property should referenciate an existing contract Agreement between the Consumer and Provider. - The agreementId property must be a string
format property in TRM The TRM shall have a dct:format property

callbackAddress property The TRM shall have a callbackAddress property - The callbackAddress is a URI (string) indicating where messages to the Consumer should be sent. - IF the address specified in the callbackAddress property is not understood THEN the Provider shall return an UNRECOVERABLE error.
dataAddress property WHERE the dct:format requires a push transfer, the TRM shall have a dataAddress property
TRM response The response after an exchanged TRM shall be either ACK or ERROR

Transfer Start Message (TSM) The Transfer Start Message (TSM) shall be sent by the participant agent acting as Provider to indicate the data transfer has been initiated. - The initiator of the TSM should be a Provider

TSM properties The TSM shall have a @context and a @type properties - The value of the context shall contain https://w3id.org/dspace/2024/1/context.jsonld - The value of the type shall be TransferStartMessage
TSM consumerPid property The TSM shall have a consumerPid property - The consumerPid property must be a string
TSM providerPid property The TSM shall have a providerPid property - The providerPid property must be a string
TSM dataAddress property WHERE the current transfer is a pull transfer and contains a transport-specific endpoint address for obtaining the data, the TSM shall have a dataAddress property
TSM resulting state A Transfer Process (TP) shall transition to the STARTED state as a result of an exchanged TSM
Transfer Suspension Message (TSuM) WHEN the participant agent acting either as Provider or Consumer needs to temporarily suspend the TP, the Transfer Suspension Message (TSuM) shall be sent.

TSuM properties The TSuM shall have a @context and a @type properties - The value of the context shall contain https://w3id.org/dspace/2024/1/context.jsonld - The value of the type shall be TransferStartMessage
TSuM consumerPid property The TSuM shall have a consumerPid property - The consumerPid property must be a string
TSuM providerPid property The TSuM shall have a providerPid property - The providerPid property must be a string
TSuM resulting state A Transfer Process (TP) shall transition to the SUSPENDED state as a result of an exchanged TSuM

Transfer Completion Message (TCM) WHERE the completion notification is not performed as part of the wire protocol of the Connector and WHEN a data transfer has completed, the participant agent acting either as Provider or Consumer shall send the Transfer Completion Message (TCM)

TCM properties The TCM shall have a @context and a @type properties - The value of the context shall contain https://w3id.org/dspace/2024/1/context.jsonld - The value of the type shall be TransferStartMessage
TCM consumerPid property The TCM shall have a consumerPid property - The consumerPid property must be a string
TCM providerPid property The TCM shall have a providerPid property - The providerPid property must be a string
TCM resulting state A Transfer Process (TP) shall transition to the COMPLETED state as a result of an exchanged TCM

Transfer Termination Message (TTM) WHEN the participant agent acting either as Provider or Consumer indicate the TP should stop and be placed in a terminal state, the Transfer Termination Message (TTM) shall be sent.

TTM properties The TTM shall have a @context and a @type properties - The value of the context shall contain https://w3id.org/dspace/2024/1/context.jsonld - The value of the type shall be TransferTerminationMessage
TTM consumerPid property The TTM shall have a consumerPid property - The consumerPid property must be a string
TTM providerPid property The TTM shall have a providerPid property - The providerPid property must be a string
TTM resulting state A Transfer Process (TP) shall transition to the TERMINATED state as a result of an exchanged TTM
Transfer Process ACK The Transfer Process shall be an object returned by a Consumer or Provider indicating a successful state change happened.

Transfer Process ACK properties The Transfer Process ACK object shall have a @context and a @type properties - The value of the context shall contain https://w3id.org/dspace/2024/1/context.jsonld - The value of the type shall be TransferProcess
Transfer Process ACK consumerPid and providerPid properties The Transfer Process ACK object shall have a consumerPid property and a providerPid property

Transfer Process ACK state property The Transfer Process ACK object shall have a "state" property. The value of the state property shall be a string with one of the valid states values: REQUESTED, STARTED, TERMINATED. COMPLETED, SUSPENDED.
Transfer Error WHEN an error has ocurred the Consumer or the Provider shall return the Transfer Error object

Transfer Error properties The Transfer Error object shall have a @context and a @type properties - The value of the context shall contain https://w3id.org/dspace/2024/1/context.jsonld - The value of the type shall be TransferError
Transfer Error consumerPid and providerPid properties The Transfer Error object shall have a consumerPid property and a providerPid property
Client Request Error handling IF a client request error occurs THEN the Connector must return an appropriate HTTP 4xx client error code
Endpoint /transfers The participant agent acting as Provider shall implement the /transfers endpoint - A CN can be accessed by a Consumer or Provider sending a GET request to transfers/:providerPid:

Endpoint /transfers response WHEN a TP is found and the client is authorized after a succesful request to the /transfers endpoint, the Provider shall return an HTTP 200 (OK) response and a body containing the TP.
Endpoint /transfers/request WHEN a Consumer POSTs a TRM to the transfers/request endpoint a TP shall be started and placed in the REQUESTED state
Endpoint /transfers/request response WHEN the request to the transfers/request endpoint is successful, the Provider shall return an HTTP 201 (Created) response with a body containing the TP.
Endpoint transfers/:providerPid/start WHEN the Consumer POSTs a TSM to the transfers/:providerPid/start endpoint, the system shall attempt to start a TP after it has been suspended.

Endpoint transfers/:providerPid/start response WHEN the TP's state is successfully transitioned after a request to the transfers/:providerPid/start endpoint, the Provider shall return an HTTP code 200 (OK)
Endpoint transfers/:providerPid/completion WHEN the Consumer POSTs a TCM to the transfers/:providerPid/completion endpoint, the system shall complete a TP.

Endpoint transfers/:providerPid/completion response WHEN the TP's state is successfully transitioned after a request to the transfers/:providerPid/completion endpoint, the Provider shall return an HTTP code 200 (OK)
Endpoint transfers/:providerPid/termination WHEN the Consumer POSTs a TTM to the transfers/:providerPid/termination endpoint, the system shall terminate a TP.

Endpoint transfers/:providerPid/termination response WHEN the TP's state is successfully transitioned after a request to the transfers/:providerPid/termination endpoint, the Provider shall return an HTTP code 200 (OK)
Endpoint transfers/:providerPid/suspension WHEN the Consumer POSTs a TSM to the transfers/:providerPid/suspension endpoint, the system shall suspend a TP.

Endpoint transfers/:providerPid/suspension response WHEN the TP's state is successfully transitioned after a request to the transfers/:providerPid/suspension endpoint, the Provider shall return an HTTP code 200 (OK)
Endpoint transfers/:consumerPid/start WHEN the Provider POSTs a TSM to the transfers/:consumerPid/start endpoint, the system shall start a TP.

Endpoint transfers/:consumerPid/start response WHEN the TP's state is successfully transitioned after a request to the transfers/:consumerPid/start endpoint, the Consumer shall return an HTTP code 200 (OK)
Endpoint transfers/:consumerPid/completion WHEN the Provider POSTs a TCM to the transfers/:consumerPid/completion endpoint, the system shall complete a TP.

Endpoint transfers/:consumerPid/completion response WHEN the TP's state is successfully transitioned after a request to the transfers/:consumerPid/completion endpoint, the Consumer shall return an HTTP code 200 (OK)
Endpoint transfers/:consumerPid/termination WHEN the Provider POSTs a TTM to the transfers/:consumerPid/termination endpoint, the system shall terminate a TP.

Endpoint transfers/:consumerPid/termination successful response WHEN the TP's state is successfully transitioned after a request to the transfers/:consumerPid/termination endpoint, the Consumer shall return an HTTP code 200 (OK)
Endpoint transfers/:consumerPid/suspension WHEN the Provider POSTs a TSM to the transfers/:consumerPid/suspension endpoint, the system shall suspend a TP.

Endpoint transfers/:consumerPid/suspension successful response WHEN the TP's state is successfully transitioned after a request to the transfers/:consumerPid/suspension endpoint, the Consumer shall return an HTTP code 200 (OK)
